name.ja_romaji: Honō no Heigen o Kakenukeru Hyakujū no Ō
name.zh-CN: 驰骋横越炎之平原的百兽之王

text.en:
3 FIRE Effect Monsters
(This card is always treated as "Salamangreat Heatleo".)
Face-up monsters on the field become FIRE. During the Main Phase, if this card was Link Summoned using "Salamangreat Heatleo" (Quick Effect): You can target 1 card your opponent controls; shuffle it into the Deck, then you can make the ATK of 1 FIRE monster your opponent controls become the ATK of 1 monster in your GY. You can only use this effect of "King of Beasts, Risen from the Valley of Flames" once per turn.
text.zh-CN:
炎属性的效果怪兽3只
此卡名在规则上视为“转生炎兽 炽热猛狮”。此卡名的②效果1回合仅可使用1次。①：场上的表侧表示怪兽变为炎属性。②：此卡是以“转生炎兽 炽热猛狮”作为素材被连接召唤的情况下，在自己・对手的主要阶段，以对手场上的1张卡为对象可以发动。将该卡放回牌组。然后，可将对手场上的1只炎属性怪兽的攻击力改成与自己墓地的1只怪兽的攻击力相同。
